verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST API v2 and per-endpoint reference pages, and it serves an llms.txt index and Markdown versions of its docs. None of the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable API spec. LLM-friendly docs and the MCP tool-to-endpoint table are adjacent features, not an API specification file, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
